_comment: Rows of ../status_machine.json that pin a defect of the current code on purpose (known_bug: the catalog id in tests/README.md), moved here unchanged: the same groups and the same row format, which the comment of that file describes. A port does not have to reproduce any of them.

first_poll.name: disarmed panel with closed zones: armed false is the only event (null -> false)
first_poll.note: The assumed initial armed state is null, so a disarmed panel counts as a change; closed zones equal the assumed initial false and emit nothing.

first_poll.name: unknown armed code 0: nothing is emitted (null stays null)
first_poll.note: An unknown armed state is never announced; a consumer keeps whatever it had.

first_poll.name: unknown armed code 3 with closed zones: nothing is emitted
codes other than 1 on the first poll are closed: nothing is emitted
captured pages: unarmed, then armed
first_poll.note: Zone codes 5 and 6 of the captures are not "open", so no sensor ever fires.

armed_codes.name: code 3 after armed: unknown (null)
armed_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 3 means "in alarm"; the bridge only maps 1, 2 and 7, so app.js just logs "Unknown armed status" and the retained armed topic keeps its old value.

armed_codes.name: code 4 after armed: unknown (null)
armed_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 4 means "sleep"; the bridge only maps 1, 2 and 7, so app.js just logs "Unknown armed status" and the retained armed topic keeps its old value.

armed_codes.name: code 5 after armed: unknown (null)
armed_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 5 means "stay"; the bridge only maps 1, 2 and 7, so app.js just logs "Unknown armed status" and the retained armed topic keeps its old value.

armed_codes.name: code 6 after armed: unknown (null)
armed_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 6 means "entry delay"; the bridge only maps 1, 2 and 7, so app.js just logs "Unknown armed status" and the retained armed topic keeps its old value.

armed_codes.name: code 8 after armed: unknown (null)
armed_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 8 means "ready"; the bridge only maps 1, 2 and 7, so app.js just logs "Unknown armed status" and the retained armed topic keeps its old value.

armed_codes.name: code 9 after armed: unknown (null)
armed_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 9 means "not ready"; the bridge only maps 1, 2 and 7, so app.js just logs "Unknown armed status" and the retained armed topic keeps its old value.

armed_codes.name: code 10 after armed: unknown (null)
armed_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 10 means "instant"; the bridge only maps 1, 2 and 7, so app.js just logs "Unknown armed status" and the retained armed topic keeps its old value.

armed_codes.name: area 2 armed while area 1 is disarmed: reported as disarmed
armed_codes.note: Only useraccess[0], the first area, is read.

armed_codes.name: area 2 armed while area 1 is unknown: nothing is emitted
area 1 armed while area 2 is disarmed: reported as armed
changes of area 2 alone are invisible

sensor_codes.name: code 2 after open: closed
sensor_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 2 means "in alarm" but only code 1 counts as open, so the sensor is announced as closed.

sensor_codes.name: code 4 after open: closed
sensor_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 4 means "open+trouble" but only code 1 counts as open, so the sensor is announced as closed.

sensor_codes.name: code 6 after open: closed
sensor_codes.note: Per the panel script notes in README.md (unverified on a real panel) 6 means "open+memory" but only code 1 counts as open, so the sensor is announced as closed.

zone_indexing.name: real zones 0 and 2 enabled, zone 1 disabled: the real zone 2 (the Hall) opens in slot 2 and nothing is seen
zone_indexing.note: login() drops the disabled zone and hands over two tuples; sensor 1 ("Hall") then reads statuszone[1], not statuszone[2].

zone_indexing.name: real zones 0 and 2 enabled, zone 1 disabled: slot 1 (the disabled zone) shows open and is reported as sensor 1, the Hall
real zones 0 and 2 enabled, zone 1 disabled: the first zone is unaffected because no disabled zone precedes it

failures.name: the login page after the session expired is an error (HTTP 200, no status tables)
failures.note: The panel gives no other sign that the session is gone; the bridge never logs in again.

failures.name: a persistently expired session fails every poll
failures.note: The listener itself keeps polling; app.js turns the first error into process.exit(1).

keep_alive_failures.name: the login page after the session expired counts as success
keep_alive_failures.note: The response is never inspected: a 2xx answer is success even when it says the session is gone (same family as KB-14).
